name: Update Event Instance
description: Update a specific instance of a recurring event. Changes apply only to the selected instance. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/update)

configurable_props.name: calendarId
configurable_props.label: Calendar ID
configurable_props.description: Optionally select the calendar, defaults to the primary calendar for the logged-in user

configurable_props.name: recurringEventId
configurable_props.label: Recurring Event ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the recurring event

configurable_props.name: instanceId
configurable_props.label: Event Instance ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the specific instance to update. Use List Event Instances action to get instance IDs.

configurable_props.name: summary
configurable_props.label: Event Title
configurable_props.description: Enter a new title for this instance

configurable_props.name: eventStartDate
configurable_props.label: Event Start Date
configurable_props.description: For all-day events, enter the Event day in the format `yyyy-mm-dd`. For events with time, format according to [RFC3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-1): `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+01:00`. A time zone offset is required unless a time zone is explicitly specified in timeZone.

configurable_props.name: eventEndDate
configurable_props.label: Event End Date
configurable_props.description: For all-day events, enter the Event day in the format `yyyy-mm-dd`. For events with time, format according to [RFC3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-1): `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+01:00`. A time zone offset is required unless a time zone is explicitly specified in timeZone.

configurable_props.name: location
configurable_props.label: Event Location
configurable_props.description: Specify a new location for this instance

configurable_props.name: description
configurable_props.label: Event Description
configurable_props.description: Enter a new description for this instance

configurable_props.name: attendees
configurable_props.label: Attendees
configurable_props.description: Enter either an array or a comma separated list of email addresses of attendees

configurable_props.name: colorId
configurable_props.label: Color ID
configurable_props.description: The color assigned to this event on your calendar. You can only select a color from the list of event colors provided from your calendar. This setting will only affect your calendar.

configurable_props.name: timeZone
configurable_props.label: Time Zone
configurable_props.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is the time zone of the calendar.

configurable_props.name: sendUpdates
configurable_props.label: Send Updates
configurable_props.description: Configure whether to send notifications about the event
